caption:
Spaghetti & Meatballs 
basic, simple, uncomplicated 

C: 65 | F: 15 | P: 38
Calories: 511 per serving 
Serves 4

50-60 grams pasta per person for a hearty meal, can be customized as per your preference
1 tsp olive oil
5-6 garlic cloves, minced
1 onion, thinly sliced
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 cup vegetable stock / chicken stock (i use one cube) , use half a cup of water if you dont have stock cubes , also liquid depends upon how watery the tomatoes are as well
6 tomatoes, blanched and crushed by hand, this gives a chunky sauce, you can blend for a smoother finish
1 tbsp dried basil
1 tsp salt + pepper 
1 tbsp red chilli flakes

Meatballs - All details in a previous reel 
450 grams chicken mince
1 tbsp garlic paste
1 grated onion
handful chopped coriander leaves / basil / parsley
45 grams cheddar cheese or whichever you prefer :) 
1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper 
1 egg
3-4 tbsp breadcrumbs / can be avoided but you wont be able shape them like traditional meatballs, 
1 tsp oil / not needed also if you want to cut the fat!

Method
add oil to a pan and cook the garlic and onion till translucent, then add in tomatoes + tomato paste + vegetable stock along with the spices and cover and allow to cook for 10-15 minutes 
add in the meatballs and allow to simmer for a few minutes
serve it fresh with pasta and cheese
